Forecasting

Bolivia Demand Model is an XGBoost demand model at 15-minute resolution. It uses CNDC regional demand forecasts, calendar signals, lagged demand, rolling windows, forecast-error lags, and regional demand lags to estimate the next demand curve.

Backtesting

For past dates, the Prediction tab compares CNDC forecast and Bolivia Demand Model against measured demand using MAE. For future dates, measured demand is intentionally hidden because it is not known yet.

Optimization

The RL-oriented dispatch target is a constrained merit-order simulation using transparent technology-level cost assumptions. It estimates how a learned control policy could shift dispatch toward lower proxy cost and higher renewable utilization.

Scope

The cost saving is a research proxy for the selected analysis date or period only. It is not audited national system saving, and it does not yet model full power-flow, unit commitment, ramp limits, or transmission constraints.
